actualDatabases.purpose: Independent read-only video Frame Rate audit of the six established live MDB/PMR pairs; no headers or OldScanner oracle.
method: Live MDB/PMR hashes, cached raw indexes and reused identity helper are verified.

Full normalized file/master IDs and active catalogue membership choose exact owners. File-owned PhysicalMedia reference supplies descriptor; only native-proven picture descriptor classes CDCI/RGBA/MPGI enter Frame Rate counts. Audio descriptor rates are excluded.
MDFL:SampleRate is read as the original signed LE32 numerator/denominator omfi:ExactEditRate pair of width8. Positive numerator and denominator are required for this research usable state.

Original numerator/denominator values and raw hex/ranges are retained. They are never snapped to 30000/1001 or 24000/1001, converted to floating-point storage, or inferred from a filename/project/master label.
File-own root CPNT:EditRate and selected-master root CPNT:EditRate are research comparisons only. No additional track traversal or runtime consistency check is proposed.
Reference-array/MobIndex declared counts must exactly match parsed entries.
limits: These are the exact rates stored in MDB, not independent verification against media essence.
No missing/nonpositive/unsupported video descriptor rate or conflicting video/file/master clock is established by this corpus. These unexercised cases still need implementation rules.

The original fractional rates differ mathematically from the familiar 1001-based broadcast ratios; retaining the original pair does not assert which clock should win in a future cross-source comparison.
No audio sample-rate policy, timecode/display rounding, header-read trigger, UI implementation or source-precedence decision is made by this probe.

proposedBellaRule.status: Proposed 19 October2026; awaiting user agreement; requirements only.
proposedBellaRule.source: Qualified physical video file -> own descriptor -> OMFI:MDFL:SampleRate.
proposedBellaRule.preserve: Original signed32 numerator and denominator plus necessary format/type meaning. Do not reduce or overwrite source pair, discard denominator or reconstruct from display text.
proposedBellaRule.usable: Complete supported typed payload, positive numerator and denominator, safe reference/owner resolution. Unusual positive rates are not rejected merely because absent from this four-rate corpus.
proposedBellaRule.missing: Proposed blank video Frame Rate cell; retain file. Audio Frame Rate blank is already agreed. Do not substitute project/master clock or infer by extension.
proposedBellaRule.retention: One selected source rate; reuse descriptor pair already required with Length where applicable. No duplicate pair or lasting formatted string solely for this column; no research comparison walks.
proposedBellaRule.semanticInterpretation: The user approved the separate provisional AvidDurationInterpreter for the qualified physical-video MDFL ExactEditRate convention; retain raw pair and apply exact native families before elapsed Duration. This does not approve all Frame Rate column sourcing/formatting choices.
proposedBellaRule.presentation: Conventional labels24/25/29.97/23.976 do not establish actual essence clock or rewrite raw value. Generic display precision remains a presentation choice.
proposedBellaRule.deferred: Frame Rate field/presentation approval, general MDB layouts/damage, other fields header policies, audio Sample Rate sourcing. Duration native video interpreter is now agreed.

frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.audio: Preserve selected MDFL Length/SampleRate as audio duration. Proposed display clock is own-file CPNT:EditRate, or supported own-slot MSLT:EditRate where applicable; never invent25fps or use48kHz asfps.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.audioRateInterpretation: Applying native ExactEditRate convention to the audio display EditRate is an additional proposed typed use; existing approved interpreter scope was physical-video MDFL SampleRate.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.frameConversion: Length * unitRateDenominator * displayRateNumerator / (unitRateNumerator * displayRateDenominator), with checked integer/rational arithmetic. Round only final audio display-frame count, nearest positive half-up proposed.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.nominalBase: Supported explicit mapping (e.g.24000/1001->24,30000/1001->30,60000/1001->60). Do not parse rounded Frame Rate strings or divide to elapsed seconds then appendFF.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.dropFrameSource: Propose own-file explicitly linked applicable timecode component and supported0/1TCCP flag, tied to compatible selected clock. Broader ancestor qualification remains unverified; no recursive sweep merely because reachable.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.dropFrameFallback: Proposed NDF when usable recorded flag absent, with absence distinguished from recordedfalse. Invalid/conflicting/incompatible flag handling remains undecided.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.precision: Preserve original count and fractions. Audio display can round to a frame without changing source samples. No extra saved formatted string or header read.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.knownZero: Agreed00:00:00:00; source-known zero distinct from unavailable.
frameTimecodeFormatterProposal20261020.largeDurations: Agreedno24-hourwrap. Preserve safe padding; unsupported/custom/high-rate coverage remains tovalidate.
